preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract (0x94e94ef27453c24a8787036a8c9d0b8ae29ed1a5).

exploit_hint: As the contract owner (0x94e94ef27453c24a8787036a8c9d0b8ae29ed1a5), call the `mint()` function with a large amount to create new tokens for yourself, thereby inflating the total supply and increasing your own balance.
